excluded_domains.name: Capcom Pictures
excluded_domains.reason: Official Capcom group information identifies Capcom Pictures as a motion-picture planning and production-management subsidiary, not a game-development studio. The prior CAPCOM U.S.A. Jobvite route was not evidence of hiring for Capcom Pictures.

excluded_domains.name: Game Boost Sweden
excluded_domains.reason: The official service is a staffing and talent marketplace connecting game studios with freelancers and consultants for gigs and contracts; it is not itself a game studio.

excluded_domains.name: Chouic
excluded_domains.reason: The company's official recruitment page identifies Chouic as a mobile-games studio for couples and friends. Its current developer catalogue includes 'Sex Game For Couple – PleaseMe' (described on the App Store as a sensual experience), 'koopla – Intimate Couple Game Cards' and an alcohol/party title Chopine. This is a material sexual-entertainment / alcohol-game portfolio rather than an isolated mature theme in an otherwise unrelated mainstream game, so it is excluded under the adult/vice policy. Revisit only if the company establishes a distinct, separately operated non-adult studio/business and hiring route.

excluded_domains.name: 3Sigma Games
excluded_domains.reason: The company's own careers page explicitly labels the business an “Adult Game Studio”. Its General Application covers VFX, editing, directing, 2D/3D art, game development, game design and related functions, and asks candidates which sector they have worked in, including adult entertainment. This is a direct company-level adult-business signal, not merely a mature theme in an individual mainstream game. Exclude under the pornography/adult-sexual-entertainment policy.

excluded_domains.name: Xatronic Software GmbH
excluded_domains.reason: The company's official Products page explicitly says it develops online casinos and online games for clients, with a focus on slot/reel games. It describes three-, four- and five-reel mechanics, bonus games and features designed to maximise players' chances of winning. The official homepage describes it as a supplier for online casino platforms and modern gambling software. This is directly within the project's iGaming/online-casino exclusion, regardless of its general software/game-development terminology.
